end.summary:
Practised copying shapes on dot and square grids by counting gaps along sides.
Counted units correctly in 7 of 9 copying attempts; counted dots instead of gaps twice, then corrected this each time.
Recognised turned or moved shapes as unchanged in 2 of 3 attempts.
Completed both tile-pattern attempts correctly; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Myra practised copying shapes by counting the gaps between dots, not the dots themselves. They explained that turning a shape keeps the same size and used a phone-turning example; the dot-and-gap mix-up was corrected later in the lesson. At home, draw short lines on dot paper and ask Myra to mark and count the gaps before writing each length.
